thread:
emma: Quick sync on prod-entry gates + costing alignment — we need to finalize the SLA tiers, pricing bands, and the minimal monitoring/alerting set for GA.

raj: +1. Primary ask: confirm latency SLO buckets (p99/p95) and cost multipliers for dedicated vs hosted. Customers keep asking about committed throughput pricing.

sofia: For docs, we should publish a simple "What you get at each tier" table and a quick migration note for Dedicated customers. I can draft but need numbers.

mike: Ops question — what are the oncall expectations at GA? Tiered oncall or shared with infra?

liz: From support: we want 24/7 critical incident routing for Dedicated Enterprise customers. For Hosted GA, business hours for standard, 24/7 for premium.

emma: Proposed SLA matrix (high level):
- Developer (free/low): best-effort latency, no SLA, community support
- Standard (hosted): 99.9% availability, p95 < 300ms for short-text workload, business-hours support
- Dedicated (reserved): 99.95% availability, p95 < 200ms, 24/7 critical support and ticket SLA

raj: Costing — recommend we publish: per-token hosted (gen) base price, embedding price, and an optional reserved capacity commit with percentile discounts. Also an ingress/egress network surcharge for private deployments.

sofia: Can we define the monitoring minimum? My suggestion: per-route token rate dashboards, model-level latency histograms, error-rate alerts at 1% sustained, and sample-response logging (1 in 1000) for QA.

ops-bot: Reminder: Current runbook for incident handoff: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-incident (link)

mike: That sounds fine. Need to document escalation hops and SLO burn alerts to PagerDuty. Also add a fallback routing policy in config for model failure -> fallback-model-v1.

emma: Agreed. Action items: 1) Raj to propose pricing bands + committed discount model (due EOD Wed). 2) Sofia to draft GA docs page + tier comparison (first draft Thu). 3) Mike to update oncall/escalation runbook (Thu). 4) Liz to write support intake SLA and routing (Thu).

raj: Quick sketch of pricing bands (nominal):
- Pay-as-you-go hosted: $0.12 / 1k tokens (generation) — entry number for docs only
- Standard plan (monthly): 10% discount after $X commit
- Dedicated reserved pool: committed monthly $Y -> 30% discount + capacity SLA
- Enterprise custom: volume + professional services

sofia: Will include a "migration note" section explaining how billing transitions from PAYG -> reserved (billing proration, commit window, metering).

liz: Support SLA excerpt for docs: "Critical incidents: 1 hour initial response, 4 hour remediation target for Dedicated" — ok to include as proposed?

emma: Fine as draft. We will iterate with legal/finance, but include as proposed text.

mike: Monitoring checklist to include in docs (short):
- Ingress QPS and tokens per second
- Per-model p95/p99 latency heatmap by region
- Error rate and 5xx tagging by class
- KV cache hit ratio and cache saturation alerts
- Auto-scaling events and queue length

sofia: For observability screenshots, can we use anonymized dashboards? I'll coordinate with observability-team.

raj: Finance asks: we need clear unit economics for hosted vs dedicated on the docs (e.g., tokens/sec cost, GPU-hour equivalents). I'll pull numbers with infra.

emma: Good. Also decision on SLA exceptions: short list we must publish (planned maintenance windows, force majeure, customer's misconfiguration). Draft language: "SLA excludes downtime caused by customer-managed network or misconfiguration."

liz: Support intake — we should require customer billing/contact info in the initial ticket for expedited routing. I'll draft the intake form.

emma: One more: rollout gating criteria to sign GA off — propose checklist: docs published, pricing public, SLA language approved by legal, runbook & oncall validated, smoke tests pass in three regions, billing integration tested.

sofia: Add: customer pilot feedback collected for top 3 regressions and addressed.

mike: Add: capacity headroom validated for 2x expected QPS for first month.

emma: OK. Let's reconvene Fri 10am to review drafts and sign the gate if ready. Flag any blockers here.

raj: Blocker: need infra cost model by Thu morning.

mike: Blocker: SRE needs a small playbook for fallback-model routing — I'll prioritize.

liz: No blocker from support side.

sofia: I'll post first doc draft in #product-docs and link here when ready.

emma: Thanks all — if anyone wants to tweak SLA numbers before legal, drop suggestions inline. :thumbsup:
